description: An interface defining methods for calculating possible next repayment amounts and eligibility for loans pending delinquency processing.

classes.name: PossibleNextRepaymentCalculationService
classes.description: Interface for calculating the next possible repayment amount and eligibility checks for a loan.

methods.name: canAccept
methods.description: Checks if the provided loan is eligible for possible next repayment calculation.

methods.name: possibleNextRepaymentAmount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the potential next repayment amount based on the given loan and next payment due date.
